summary: MKDWELL Tech Inc. furnished a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A, audited financial statements of Landvision Technology Limited, and unaudited pro forma combined financial information with Landvision Inc., indicating a prior acquisition. No transaction terms, special-situation event, or board action are disclosed in this routine earnings report furnished under Rule 13a-16. The exhibits are incorporated by reference into existing Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements.
